Daler Mehndi faces backlash over Uttarakhand show; celebrities defend singer

Singer Daler Mehndi is facing backlash following a show in Uttarakhand. Several celebrities have come to his defense. Anupam Kher backed Mehndi after a confrontation involving a BJP minister. Mika Singh and Kapil Sharma also defended the singer. Sona Mohapatra recalled a "disappointing" Delhi show by Mehndi amid the controversy.
